plainTranslation:
This is an easy emotional fit. One person's personality tends to work well with the other person's needs, so the relationship can feel calm, familiar, and simple in a good way.

You may not have to explain yourself as much with this person. Being together can feel like a break from the usual effort of being understood. There's a softness here, but it doesn't have to be sentimental.

The problem is that easy can become lazy. Because the connection feels natural, both people may assume it will just keep going without much care.

Don't sleep on the good thing just because it isn't causing problems. Keep showing up for it.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
